up: Return the first 1000 activity rows for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1955 (Vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 3) where the standard type is IC50, the standard relation is exactly '=', and the pChEMBL value is not null. The output should include assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: WITH target AS (SELECT tid, target_type, tax_id FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1955') SELECT assays.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, target.target_type, target.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, activities.standard_type, activities.pchembl_value FROM activities JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN target ON assays.tid = target.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON activities.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE activities.standard_type = 'IC50' AND activities.standard_relation = '=' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, assays.chembl_id LIMIT 1000;
